_meta.scope: Year-tagged Group 4 PYQ, lang=en; ta twins share the same topic

topics.physics: Physics: mechanics, force, momentum, energy, optics/lenses, sound, heat, electricity, magnetism, units, modern physics
topics.chemistry: Chemistry: elements/compounds, acids-bases-salts, metallurgy, electrochemistry, organic groups, everyday chemistry
topics.biology-botany: Botany: plant physiology, photosynthesis, plant classification, plant reproduction, algae/fungi
topics.biology-zoology: Zoology & human physiology: blood, hormones, organs, reproduction, cells, genetics, diseases, nutrition/vitamins
topics.agriculture-science: Fertilizers, pesticides, insecticides, crop science, biofertilizers, food adulterants
topics.astronomy-space: Universe, planets, satellites, comets, asteroids, ISRO/space missions, atomic energy programme
topics.environment: Environmental science, ecosystems, pollution, eutrophication, greenhouse gases, wildlife protection
topics.science-tech-current: Latest inventions, IT/computers, technology current affairs, science days

topics.earth-location: Earth location, latitudes/longitudes, world geography, continents, deserts, world lakes, borders
topics.physical-features-india: Himalayas, plains, plateaus, physical features of India
topics.rivers-water: Rivers, tributaries, water resources, river landforms
topics.forest-wildlife: Forests, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks, biosphere reserves
topics.agriculture-pattern: Crop production patterns, shifting cultivation, agricultural geography
topics.tn-geography: Tamil Nadu specific geography: windfarms, hills, TN sanctuaries, TN forest cover, Chennai

history.unit: Unit III: History, Culture of India, and Indian National Movement

topics.indus-valley: Indus Valley Civilization, Harappan sites and excavations
topics.ancient-india: Vedic age, prehistory, Mauryas, Guptas, ancient literature, archaeology
topics.south-indian-history: Pallavas, Cholas, Sangam-era kings, TN excavations, south Indian literature
topics.early-uprisings-renaissance: 1857 and early revolts, socio-religious reform movements, national renaissance, British-era acts
topics.inc-freedom-movement: Indian National Congress, Gandhian era, revolutionary movement, partition-era plans
topics.national-leaders: Leader-specific questions (Ambedkar, Bhagat Singh, Tagore, VOC, Nehru, Bharathiar, etc.)
topics.tn-agitations: Tamil Nadu movements: Justice Party, Devadasi abolition, Muthulakshmi Ammaiyar, labour strikes
topics.indian-culture: Unity in diversity, religion, language, arts, Thirukkural-in-GS, secular state
topics.misc-current-affairs: Awards, modern world events, unclassifiable fragments mislabeled History

topics.constitution-basics: Constitution, Preamble, salient features, amendments, Union/State/UT structure, citizenship, Constituent Assembly
topics.fundamental-rights: Fundamental Rights (Part III), writ-related rights, reservation
topics.federalism-centre-state: Centre-State relations, Finance Commission, inter-state council, related commissions
topics.judiciary: Judiciary, Supreme Court, High Courts, writs, rule of law, Lok Adalat
topics.human-rights: Human Rights Charter, social justice, child rights
topics.political-parties-system: Political parties and political systems, anti-defection, political theory
topics.misc-current-affairs: GK/current-affairs questions labeled Polity by extraction (census, UN bodies, awards, schemes)

economy.unit: Unit V: Indian Economy and Development Administration in Tamil Nadu

topics.economy-basics: Nature of Indian economy, national income concepts, inflation, economic thought, 1991 reforms
topics.five-year-plans: Five-year plans, early plan proposals, Planning Commission, NITI Aayog, NDC
topics.revenue-banking-gst: Taxes, GST, RBI, monetary policy, Finance Commission, FERA, financial inclusion
topics.agriculture-land: Green/colour revolutions, food security, agri policy, KCC, crops
topics.industry: Industrial policy, PSUs, MRTP, specific industries, Make in India, energy
topics.rural-welfare-schemes: Central rural welfare and poverty eradication schemes (JGSY, NSAP, EAS, NRLM, etc.)
topics.social-problems: Population, poverty concepts, education system, health (national level)
topics.tn-schemes-development: TN welfare schemes, TN education/health systems, TN economy/GSDP, GI tags, TN industry
topics.misc-current-affairs: International groupings, awards, one-off current events mislabeled Economy

tnhistory.unit: Unit VI: History, Culture, Heritage, and Socio-Political Movements of Tamil Nadu

topics.tamil-society-archaeology: History of Tamil society, archaeological discoveries (Keezhadi, Sivakalai), Sangam-era kingdoms, ancient TN trade and temples
topics.tamil-literature: Tamil literature from Sangam to contemporary, authors and works, Tamil antiquity
topics.tn-freedom-struggle: TN role in freedom struggle: Palayakkarars, Kattabomman, Velu Nachiyar, VOC, early agitations
topics.social-reformers: Social reformers and movements: Periyar, Muthulakshmi, Iyothee Thass, Ramalinga Adigal, Devadasi abolition, labour movement
topics.tn-politics: Madras Presidency / TN political history: Justice Party ministries, CMs, Anna, Dravidian movement politics
topics.misc-modern-tn: Modern TN administrative/infrastructure facts mislabeled into this unit
